app.title: SnapTunes - From Snap to Sound
app.description: Create Spotify playlists instantly from images or text with SnapTunes. Powered by AI and OCR, we turn your moments into music.
app.keywords: SnapTunes, AI playlist generator, OCR music app, image to music, text to playlist

step1.title: 1. Spotify Authentication
step1.description: You need to log in with your Spotify account to create a playlist.
step1.readyToContinue: ✓ Ready to continue to next step

step2.title: 2. Enter Song Titles / Artists
step2.description: Upload an image or enter song titles/artists directly.
step2.descriptionV1: Extract text from images using OCR and enter song titles and artists directly. Suitable when you have an accurate list of songs.
step2.descriptionV2: Enter an image or text and GPT Vision AI will analyze automatically. Recognizes everything from image mood, text themes, to exact song lists and recommends appropriate songs.
step2.placeholder: Enter song titles and artists (one per line)
step2.placeholderV2: Upload an image or enter text. GPT will analyze automatically.

step3.title: 3. Search Songs on Spotify
step3.description: Search for the extracted songs/artists on Spotify.

step4.title: 4. Create Playlist
step4.description: Create a Spotify playlist with the selected songs.

errors.imageExtractionFailed: Failed to extract text from image.
errors.noSongsExtracted: No songs could be extracted. Please try a different text or upload a clearer image.
errors.searchFirst: Please search songs on Spotify first.
